content:
Warmest birthday greetings to our Honorable Prime Minister, Shri @narendramodi Ji! 💐
Your visionary leadership, unwavering commitment to nation-building, and tireless dedication to the service of 140 crore Indians continue to redefine good governance and elevate our nation's standing globally. Under your stewardship, India is steadily marching towards the vision of Viksit Bharat.
On behalf of the legal fraternity and the state of Odisha, I pray to Lord Jagannath for your good health, long life, and continued strength to lead the Nation to greater heights.
comment: Long-term nation-building also depends on how policy goals translate into measurable outcomes at the local level, with institutions, legal systems, and citizens all playing a role in implementation.
